decisions.decision: N5 sentences remain non-release while their canonical grammar records remain non-release.
decisions.reason: Phase 2 must not silently promote the Phase 1 N5 grammar inventory.

decisions.decision: Canonical sentences retain their deterministic curriculum links; compact release output omits links to non-release curriculum units.
decisions.reason: All current curriculum units are development-only, and compact release bundles must not contain dangling references.

decisions.decision: All Japanese sentences, readings, translations, and notes are original JapanGo editorial content.
decisions.reason: Textbooks and third-party example corpora are excluded as sentence sources.
